raw_request.question: How should input bytes be decoded, and should Unicode characters be normalized?
raw_request.why_it_matters: The encoding and Unicode policy determine which files are accepted and whether visually similar text changes its character sequence.
raw_request.recommendation_reason: UTF-8 with unchanged Unicode provides a portable contract without silently changing character content.
